title: Rav Yehudah bar Idi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Rosh Hashanah 31a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.31a.13), where he said in the name of Rabbi Yohanan: “The Shekhinah traveled ten journeys.” Dikdukei Soferim cites the reading “Rabbi Yehudah bar Idi said in the name of Rabbi Oshaya”; Yuchasin HaShalem has the same reading.
A homily of his appears in Tanchuma, Bereshit 21: the decree against the generation of the Flood was not sealed until they wrote gamkisum (marriage documents) for males and for animals.

notes.text: Hyman reports an Oshaya transmission in place of Yohanan. “Gamkisum” preserves his printed term and his own gloss “marriage document.”

The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1684&lang=en) give Rabbi Yochanan as the source of the ten journeys teaching. The Oshaya attribution in Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin HaShalem remains Hyman’s report.
